column1: 21495§aspiration§ˌæspəˈreɪʃn§A building reflects the ideas and aspirations of the designer and client.§建筑物反映出设计者和客户的理念与**渴望**。§
21496§considerable§kənˈsɪdərəbl§The heavy snow blocks the highway, so we have to take considerable detours.§大雪使得公路封锁，所以我们不得不绕道而行，为此多走了**很多**路。§
21497§clumsy§ˈklʌmzi§These oversized clumsy cars would slow down traffic.§这些体形硕大而**笨拙**的汽车会减缓交通的速度。§
21498§gleam§gliːm§The church steeple gleamed in the sunlight.§教堂的尖塔在阳光下**闪闪发光**。§
21499§fascinate§ˈfæsɪneɪt§The very style of the old house fascinates.§这个老房子的风格本身就**令人着迷**。§
21500§supervise§ˈsuːpəvaɪz§Mary supervises the work of the department.§玛丽**指导**该部门的工作。§
21501§evaluate§ɪˈvæljueɪt§We evaluated the students' skills on the basis of test results.§我们在考试成绩的基础上对学生的技能进行**评估**。§
21502§curiosity§ˌkjʊəriˈɒsəti§The relentless curiosity of scientific researchers brought the forces of nature to light.§科研人员无尽的**好奇心**是自然力量发现的源泉。§
21503§residential§ˌrezɪˈdenʃl§Smith House is one of the oldest residential colleges of the university.§史密斯学院是这所大学最古老的**寄宿**学院之一。§
21504§sole§səʊl§His sole motive was to make her happy.§他**唯一**的动机就是让她高兴。§
21505§decade§ˈdekeɪd§In Tokyo builders are planning a massive underground city to be begun in the next decade.§在东京，建筑师们正计划在今后的**十年**里大规模兴建地下城。§
21506§survey§ˈsɜːveɪ§A recent survey of staff found that 90 percent welcomed having clothing which reflected the corporate identity.§最近的一项员工**调查**发现，90％的员工欣然接受穿能够反映企业形象的工装。§
21507§fitting§ˈfɪtɪŋ§If you want to buy a pair of trousers, a fitting is very necessary.§如果你想买一条裤子，**试穿**非常必要。§
21508§rudimentary§ˌruːdɪˈmentri§New staff were given only rudimentary training at the beginning of their work.§新员工在工作之初只接受了**最基本**的训练。§改例句：staff 作集体名词不加 -s，staffs 改 staff

21509§courtship§ˈkɔːtʃɪp§This contact may help to maintain order within a group, and stroking or touching are part of the courtship ritual in most species.§这种接触也许有助于维持一个群体里的秩序，而在大多数物种中，抚摸或接触是**求爱**仪式中的一部分。§
21510§ritual§ˈrɪtʃuəl§It is interesting to observe, for instance, some decline in the emphasis given to marriage rituals.§我们发现很有意思的情况，例如，人们对结婚**典礼**的热衷程度在减弱。§
21511§stereoscopic§ˌsteriəˈskɒpɪk§The position of the eyes so restricts the field of vision in baleen whales that they probably do not have stereoscopic vision.§由于须鲸眼睛的位置限制了视野，它们可能没有**立体**视觉。§
21512§interface§ˈɪntəfeɪs§The new version of the program has a much better user interface than the original.§新版程序比旧版的用户**界面**要好得多。§

21513§preliminary§prɪˈlɪmɪnəri§Although preliminary experimental evidence suggests that their in-air vision is poor, the accuracy with which dolphins leap high to take small fish out of a trainer's hand provides evidence to the contrary.§尽管**先前**的试验证明海豚在空气中的视力很差，但它们可以一跃到空中获取训练者手中的小鱼，这种准确度成为与之前的结论相反的证据。§

21514§turbid§ˈtɜːbɪd§Vision is obviously more useful to species inhabiting clear open waters than to those living in turbid rivers and flooded plains.§显而易见，与那些生活在**浑浊**的小河里和河漫滩里的物种相比，视力对生活在干净清澈水域里的物种更加有用。§
21515§repertoire§ˈrepətwɑː(r)§The Royal Shakespeare Company also have many modern plays in their repertoire.§英国皇家莎士比亚剧团的**常备剧目**中也有很多现代剧。§
21516§monotonous§məˈnɒtənəs§The play became monotonous after a while.§过了一会儿，这部剧就变得**单调乏味**了。§
21517§speculation§ˌspekjuˈleɪʃn§Rumours that the two singers are about to marry have been dismissed as pure speculation.§关于那两位歌手要结婚的谣言仅仅是**猜测**，无人再理会。§

21518§resemble§rɪˈzembl§When we tested four totally blind volunteers using the same list, we found that their choices closely resembled those made by the sighted subjects.§当使用同样的表单对四位盲人志愿者进行测试时，我们发现他们的选择与视力正常的实验对象的选择极其**相似**。§
21519§perspective§pəˈspektɪv§We were encouraged to see the issue from a different perspective.§我们受到鼓励，从不同的**视角**来看待这个问题。§改例句：perspective of view 重复累赘，删 of view
21520§rendition§renˈdɪʃn§The singer gave a moving rendition of the famous song “You Are Not Alone”.§这位歌手深情**演绎**了一首著名歌曲《你不孤单》。§
21521§metaphorical§ˌmetəˈfɒrɪkl§The word has a literal as well as a metaphorical meaning.§这个单词有字面意思，也有**隐喻**义。§
21522§interpret§ɪnˈtɜːprɪt§I wanted to discover whether there were differences in how the blind and the sighted interpreted colours.§我希望可以发现失明者与有视力者对颜色的**描述**是否有所不同。§
21523§perimeter§pəˈrɪmɪtə(r)§A river runs along one side of the field's perimeter.§小河沿着这块土地**周边**的一边延伸。§改译文：原译文没译出 perimeter，加「周边」
21524§jerk§dʒɜːk§He indicated the bedroom with a jerk of his head.§他用头的**猝然一动**示意了卧室的方向。§
21525§visual§ˈvɪʒuəl§The exhibition of London Museum is largely visual, with a huge number of items on show.§伦敦博物馆的展览以**视觉**展示为主，展出了大量物品。§改译文：原译「让人大开眼界」没译出 largely visual（以视觉为主），改译
21526§horror§ˈhɒrə(r)§He was filled with horror at the sight of the dog.§他看见狗就**不寒而栗**。§
21527§distort§dɪˈstɔːt§Many people are concerned that an excessive emphasis on humanity's genetic constitution may distort our sense of values.§许多人担心过分强调人类基因构成可能会**扭曲**人类的价值观。§
21528§expose§ɪkˈspəʊz§He has been widely exposed on television to the public.§他经常在电视上向公众**露面**。§
21529§sponge§spʌndʒ§He squeezed out water from a sponge.§他拧出了**海绵**里的水。§
21530§audition§ɔːˈdɪʃn§I became a professional singer after I took many auditions.§经过多次**试唱**，我成了一名职业歌手。§
21531§reliable§rɪˈlaɪəbl§Three speed cycles are simple and reliable to ride around the town.§在城里还是骑三速自行车比较简便和**可靠**。§
21532§abstraction§æbˈstrækʃn§Logic, rationality and abstraction have their origins in the left hemisphere.§逻辑、推理和**抽象**思维都源自大脑左半球。§
21533§mount§maʊnt§The eruption in May 1980 of Mount St. Helens astounded the world with its violence.§1980年5月，圣海伦斯**山**火山爆发，其威力震惊了世界。§
21534§announce§əˈnaʊns§In 1989, a team of American and Canadian archaeologists announced that they had found the site of an ancient city.§1989年，一个由美国和加拿大的考古学家组成的考古小组**宣布**，他们发现了一处古城遗址。§
21535§headline§ˈhedlaɪn§What sort of national events make headlines in your country?§在贵国，哪种类型的国内事件会成为**头条新闻**呢？§
21536§collapse§kəˈlæps§The whole market collapsed, as a matter of fact, and coffee became cheaper than it had been for the previous 25 years.§事实上，（咖啡）市场全盘**崩溃**，咖啡的售价跌到25年来的最低。§
21537§assistance§əˈsɪstəns§The farmers are to receive financial assistance to help see them through the severe drought.§农民们将得到经济**援助**，以帮助他们度过这场严重的旱灾。§改例句：句号前多了一个空格
21538§discriminate§dɪˈskrɪmɪneɪt§We must learn to discriminate right from wrong.§我们必须学会**明辨**是非。§
21539§destructive§dɪˈstrʌktɪv§The lungs of children who grow up in polluted air offer further evidence of its destructive power.§那些呼吸着污浊空气长大的孩子们的肺部状况进一步证明，污浊空气具有**毁坏性**力量。§
21540§authority§ɔːˈθɒrəti§Dark colours give an aura of authority while lighter pastel shades suggest approachability.§深色调给人一种**权威**的感觉，而清淡柔和的色调使人感到亲切。§
21541§mild§maɪld§The thief just got a mild punishment.§小偷只受到了**轻微**的惩罚。§
21542§capacity§kəˈpæsəti§Without genetic variability a species lacks the capacity to evolve and cannot adapt to changes in its environment.§如果没有遗传的多样性，物种就会缺乏进化的**能力**，也就不能适应其环境的变化。§
21543§latitude§ˈlætɪtjuːd§Our position is latitude 40 degrees south.§我们的位置是南**纬**40度。§
21544§circus§ˈsɜːkəs§The circus trainer snapped his whip.§**马戏团**驯兽师把鞭子抽得啪啪响。§
21545§grin§grɪn§Sarah tried several times to catch Philip's eye, but he just grinned at her.§萨拉几次试图吸引菲利普的注意，但他只是对她**咧嘴笑**笑。§
21546§democratic§ˌdeməˈkrætɪk§The school held a democratic election for student-council officers.§学校进行了一次**民主**选举来挑选学生会成员。§
21547§install§ɪnˈstɔːl§In the noisiest areas, mechanical ventilation will have to be installed in the exterior walls.§在最喧闹的地区，其外墙上必须**安装**机械通风装置。§
21548§faculty§ˈfæklti§Here on this campus we have the faculties of Architecture and Law.§这所大学里设有建筑**学院**和法学院。§
21549§institution§ˌɪnstɪˈtjuːʃn§Such a record will allow you to present your linguistic credentials to academic institutions.§这份记录将允许你将自己的语言证书呈递给学术**机构**。§
21550§probability§ˌprɒbəˈbɪləti§This is a tool for predicting the probability that a species will become extinct in a particular region over a specific period.§这是一种用来预测某一物种在某个特定时期、特定区域灭绝的**可能性**的工具。§
21551§bizarre§bɪˈzɑː(r)§The story is of certain bizarre interest.§这个故事有一种**怪诞**的趣味。§
21552§gravity§ˈgrævəti§This increased the arrow's stability by moving the centre of gravity to a position below the rocket.§通过将**重**心移到火箭下方来增加整支箭的稳定性。§
21553§cap§kæp§The sand dredged from the waters will be used to provide a two-metre capping layer over the granite platform.§从水里挖出的沙子将被用来覆盖在大理石平台上，该**覆盖**层厚达两米。§
21554§external§ɪkˈstɜːnl§The evidence we have suggests that domestic trade was greater than external trade at all periods.§我们掌握的证据表明，无论在哪个时期，国内贸易都要比**对外**贸易发达。§
21555§absurd§əbˈsɜːd§Wearing a swimming suit during a snowstorm is absurd.§在暴风雪中穿泳装可真**荒唐**。§
21556§separate§ˈsepəreɪt§The solution is not to separate teaching and research, but to recognize that the combination is difficult.§这种解决方案不是要将教学与研究**分离**开，而是承认它们的结合是困难的。§
21557§inclination§ˌɪnklɪˈneɪʃn§Developing photos requires a darkroom and the time and inclination to handle the necessary chemicals.§冲洗照片需要一间暗室、一些时间并且**愿意**接触冲印过程中所必需的一些化学药剂。§
